scientific_question: Can two learned late-depth nonlinear atom banks represent the seven late dense MLP functions when every layer may independently recombine the paired c_fc boundary and c_proj write of every matched neuron?

causal_basis.seven_trunk_finding: Seven full-width trunks are the strongest compact MLP result: +0.0262 CE at 0.5TPP and +0.0698 CE at 5TPP, but the late shared groups retain endpoint and JVP mismatch.
causal_basis.layer_axis_finding: Seven whole-matrix coefficients per layer are insufficient: held-out output recovery 0.6291, input-JVP recovery 0.2954, and fixed CE gap +2.1089 after healthy optimization.
causal_basis.selected_atom_finding: Privatizing the strongest 128 complete neurons per late layer is insufficient; the missing coordinate change is distributed across the common hidden frame.
causal_basis.residual_spectrum_finding: Rank-64 residual subspaces transfer across token banks, but actual residual directions have only 0.036-0.049 cross-bank cosine. A single static low-rank correction is not authorized.
causal_basis.representation_change: Keep the five singleton trunks and two late trunks, align the two late banks by a deterministic function-preserving complete-neuron permutation, then give each late layer and neuron independent c_fc-side and c_proj-side interpolation coefficients. This distributes two-sided coordinate freedom over all 3072 atoms without ambient private matrices.
causal_basis.not_a_sweep: There is one deterministic pairing, two scalar coefficients per late-layer atom, one two-stage optimizer path, one seed, and no bank-count, matching, coefficient, optimizer, or restart sweep.

family.definition: For late layer l and matched atom j, u_lj=a_lj*u_Aj+(1-a_lj)*u_Bpi(j) and v_lj=b_lj*v_Aj+(1-b_lj)*v_Bpi(j), followed by the existing per-layer signed pre-GELU and residual-output gains.
family.pairing: Normalize each c_fc row and paired c_proj column separately, concatenate them with equal norm weight, compute cosine candidates, and deterministically greedily choose a one-to-one maximum-similarity matching from each A atom to a B atom using top-k 64 candidates plus exact unmatched completion. Apply the same permutation to B c_fc rows, B c_proj columns, and B-side initialization gains, preserving the B-bank function exactly.
family.initialization: Layers 0-4 select their singleton banks. Layers 5-7 set both atomwise coefficients to 1 and exactly select late bank A. Layers 8-11 set both coefficients to 0 and exactly select the aligned late bank B. The initial function is exactly the sealed seven-trunk endpoint.
family.deployment: Materialize and cache one ordinary dense c_fc/c_proj pair per layer after a parameter refresh. Token-time and inference GEMM FLOPs are unchanged and there is no token router.

fit_protocol.objective: Equal-weight sum of separately normalized clean-output error and central-difference direction error on dense-teacher and seven-trunk state banks, identical to the corrected parent teacher-fit metric.

stages.name: coefficients_only
stages.trainable: the two 7x3072 late-layer atom coefficient matrices only

stages.name: joint_banks_coefficients
stages.trainable: seven bank matrix pairs, atomwise coefficients, pre-GELU gains, and residual-output gains

fit_protocol.best_state_rule: Within each stage preserve the state with the smallest discovery objective. The second stage warm-starts the first. Holdout values, fixed CE, wall time, and gate outcomes never select a state.
fit_protocol.parameter_clamps: Atom coefficients are clamped to [-1,2], pre-GELU gains to [-4,4], and residual-output log gains to [-4,4]. Bank matrices are unconstrained.

report: deterministic pairing digest and semantic-similarity statistics
exact endpoint reconstruction error before fitting
stagewise discovery and holdout value-direction objectives
held-out output and analytic input-JVP recovery by layer and state bank
atomwise coefficient spectra and endpoint displacement by layer
fixed-checkpoint validation CE after the terminal stage
parameter, reconstruction-FLOP, peak-memory, and wall-time accounting

frozen_gates.optimization_healthy: Finite terminal execution and either terminal discovery objective at most 0.5 or at least 50-percent reduction from the joint-stage initial objective.

decision_rule.pass: Implement this exact family in the LM model, measure exact-config MFU, and launch only a 124M/0.5TPP verification if MFU is at least 20 percent.
decision_rule.healthy_fail: Reject two-bank atomwise recombination without sweeping bank count, pairing, or optimizer. The missing transformation requires a richer distributed nonlinear chart than scalar interpolation between two paired atom banks.
decision_rule.optimization_inconclusive: Stop and report without LM training or a capacity conclusion.

authorization.allowed: Implement and run this exact zero-LM-update teacher-fit ceiling after focused tests and measured preflight.
not_allowed: language-model training before every functional and CE gate passes
bank-count, matching, coefficient, optimizer, learning-rate, stage-length, seed, gain, or regularizer sweeps
authorization.callback_policy: Foreground-poll if measured complete runtime is at most five minutes; otherwise launch one verified terminal/failure @Codex watchdog.
